name: Chthonic-Veil
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are bioluminescent seas, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
There is money in medicinal compounds and biomass and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
